attributes.name: Orange War Paint
attributes.powers: Display this card next to your deck. While displayed, when you would bury a card from your hand or deck to use a character power that adds to your Melee check you may discard that card instead. When you fail a combat check or play another card that has the Paint trait, bury this card; if you have the Melee skill, discard it instead.
